notes.title: "Xiaoxiao Qunxiong" will undergo a major update on July 31st!!
notes.notes: [p]New buildings.[/p][p]Wooden barriers, barricades, and iron gates: used to block enemies[/p][p]Sink, water tank, and well: can restore the stamina of nearby friendly troops[/p][p]Emergency tent: It allows soldiers who have died in battle to return to the battlefield[/p][p]Watchtower: Extensive field of vision[/p][p][/p][p]New gameplay:[/p][p]You can now dispatch legions to explore and move within the large map.[/p][p]In both defending and attacking city battles, the situation of the city will change based on its defense.[/p][p]AI is now capable of attacking each other.[/p][p][/p][p]Numerical adjustments have been made to all equipment[/p][p]The enemy count has been adjusted[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed many bugs[/p][p][/p][p]More details can be fully experienced within the game.[/p]

notes.title: Patch update on May 1st
notes.notes:
Add mounts and war elephants.

Added several war elephant related features.

Modified the bug that resulted in zero agricultural yield due to the upgrade of fisheries and forestry.

notes.title: (Major update!!!) Little Heroes updated on April 23
notes.notes:
Added a new ethnic system. Different ethnic groups have their own unique technologies, soldier characteristics and general skills. Four ethnic groups are temporarily available.

Added Green Forest Mansion and Horse Farm buildings to the large map.

Blacksmiths manufacture equipment, and there is a certain chance of rare equipment or epic equipment.

The soldier skill panel has been changed. Swordsman and Martial Artist have been removed, and armor breaking, parrying, beast control, and engineering have been added.

Added soldier characteristic functions, and each soldier will have his own unique characteristics.

Soldiers can now serve as generals.

Added new weapon types: axe, scimitar, spear, crossbow, catapult, ballista, and rattan shield.

Added rattan armor to armor.

notes.title: Pequeños Héroes actualizado el 28 de febrero
notes.notes:
Se añade un nuevo sistema de estaciones, que se divide en primavera, verano, otoño e invierno según los meses. Las diferentes estaciones tendrán diferentes efectos artísticos. En otoño, la producción agrícola aumenta en un 50%, en invierno, la producción agrícola se reduce en un 75% y otras industrias se reducen en un 25%.

Se agregó un nuevo sistema de tecnología. El sistema de investigación original se cambió a un sistema de árbol de tecnología y se agregaron puntos de tecnología. Ahora la investigación ya no requiere tiempo, sino que consume dinero y los puntos de tecnología se pueden obtener luchando contra enemigos o comprándolos en el mercado.

El campamento militar ha sido ajustado. Entrenar soldados en el campamento militar ya no requiere consumir puntos de acción, sino que utiliza libros militares, lo que facilita a los jugadores aumentar rápidamente su nivel de ejército.

Se ha ajustado el consumo de resistencia de la armadura. Ahora equipado con armadura, la lucha consumirá más resistencia.

notes.title: Updated on December 15th
notes.notes:
Localized Text Addition
Modified the issue where clicking on the unlock equipment button on the soldier interface would cause the progress bar to jump.

notes.title: Update on December 14th
notes.notes:
The soldier interface allows soldiers to customize their names.
The soldier interface has added the function of using attribute results.
The soldier interface has added the function of editing different types of troops and unlocking talents with one click equipment.
Nowadays, the deployment and construction of buildings are no longer done once a month, but rather require physical exertion. Players can choose their own number of battles and constructions for this month.
Strategy no longer consumes action power, but instead consumes reconnaissance points and money.
Now in battle, you can adjust the game speed and pause the game.
The supplies can be used with shortcut keys.
After the battle, the troops withdrew. The drop of talent equipment depends on the difficulty.
Simple difficulty 20% Normal difficulty 50% Difficult difficulty 80% Extremely difficult difficulty 100%
Next is numerical modification
Increased the amount of resources that can be produced by territorial and resource buildings.
Significantly reduced the wealth value of the enemy legion.
Reduced the combat effectiveness of high-level enemy legions.
Reduced enemy soldier attributes based on difficulty.
